items.source: The example above creates an EntityManagerFactory using the DataSource bean qualified with @Qualifier("second"). It scans entities located in the same package as Order. It is possible to map additional JPA properties using the app.jpa namespace. The use of @Bean(defaultCandidate=false) allows the secondJpaProperties and secondEntityManagerFactory beans to be defined without interfering with auto-configured beans of the same type.
items.translation: 上面的示例使用带有 @Qualifier("second") 限定符的 DataSource Bean 创建了一个 EntityManagerFactory。 它扫描与 Order 位于同一包中的实体。 可以使用 app.jpa 命名空间来映射额外的 JPA 属性。 使用 @Bean(defaultCandidate=false) 允许定义 secondJpaProperties 和 secondEntityManagerFactory Bean，而不会干扰同类型的自动配置 Bean。

items.source: To configure your own DataSource, define a @Bean of that type in your configuration. Spring Boot reuses your DataSource anywhere one is required, including database initialization. If you need to externalize some settings, you can bind your DataSource to the environment (see Third-party Configuration).
items.translation: 要配置您自己的DataSource，请在您的配置中定义该类型的@Bean。 Spring Boot 会在任何需要 DataSource 的地方重用您的实例，包括数据库初始化。 如果您需要将某些设置外部化，可以将您的DataSource绑定到环境（参见第三方配置）。

items.source: To define an additional DataSource, an approach that’s similar to the previous section can be used. A key difference is that the DataSource @Bean must be declared with defaultCandidate=false. This prevents the auto-configured DataSource from backing off.
items.translation: 要定义一个额外的DataSource，可以采用与上一节类似的方法。关键区别在于，@Bean必须声明为defaultCandidate=false。这可以防止自动配置的DataSource被回退。

items.source: As with configuring a single custom DataSource, the type of one or both of the DataSource beans can be customized using the type(Class) method on DataSourceBuilder. See Supported Connection Pools for details of the supported types.
items.translation: 与配置单个自定义DataSource一样，可以使用 DataSourceBuilder 上的 type(Class) 方法自定义一个或两个 DataSource bean 的类型。有关支持类型的详细信息，请参阅支持的连接池。

items.source: Spring Data can create implementations of Repository interfaces of various flavors. Spring Boot handles all of that for you, as long as those Repository implementations are included in one of the auto-configuration packages, typically the package (or a sub-package) of your main application class that is annotated with @SpringBootApplication or @EnableAutoConfiguration.
items.translation: Spring Data 可以创建各种风格的 Repository 接口的实现。只要这些 Repository 实现包含在某个自动配置包中，Spring Boot 就会为您处理所有相关事务。通常，该包（或子包）是您主应用程序类所在的包，且该类已标注了 @SpringBootApplication 或 @EnableAutoConfiguration。

items.source: Spring Data JPA and Spring Data Mongo can both automatically create Repository implementations for you. If they are both present on the classpath, you might have to do some extra configuration to tell Spring Boot which repositories to create. The most explicit way to do that is to use the standard Spring Data @EnableJpaRepositories and @EnableMongoRepositories annotations and provide the location of your Repository interfaces.
items.translation: Spring Data JPA 和 Spring Data Mongo 都可以自动为您创建Repository实现。如果它们同时存在于类路径中，您可能需要进行一些额外的配置来告诉 Spring Boot 要创建哪些仓库。最明确的方法是标准使用 Spring Data@EnableJpaRepositories和@EnableMongoRepositories注解，并提供您的Repository接口的位置。

items.source: Hibernate uses two different naming strategies to map names from the object model to the corresponding database names. The fully qualified class name of the physical and the implicit strategy implementations can be configured by setting the spring.jpa.hibernate.naming.physical-strategy and spring.jpa.hibernate.naming.implicit-strategy properties, respectively. Alternatively, if ImplicitNamingStrategy or PhysicalNamingStrategy beans are available in the application context, Hibernate will be automatically configured to use them.
items.translation: Hibernate 使用两种不同的命名策略将对象模型中的名称映射到相应的数据库名称。 物理和隐式策略实现的完全限定类名可以通过分别设置spring.jpa.hibernate.naming.physical-strategy和spring.jpa.hibernate.naming.implicit-strategy属性进行配置。 或者，如果应用程序上下文中存在ImplicitNamingStrategy或PhysicalNamingStrategybean，Hibernate 将自动配置为使用它们。

items.source: As described in Supported Connection Pools, DataSourceBuilder supports several different connection pools. To use a pool other than Hikari, add it to the classpath, use the type(Class) method to specify the pool class to use, and update the @Bean method’s return type to match. This will also provide you with configuration property metadata for the specific connection pool that you’ve chosen.
items.translation: 如支持的连接池中所描述，DataSourceBuilder支持多种不同的连接池。若要使用除 Hikari 以外的连接池，请将其添加到类路径中，使用 type(Class) 方法指定要使用的连接池类，并更新@Bean方法的返回类型以匹配。这还将为您提供所选特定连接池的配置属性元数据。

items.source: By default, Spring Boot configures the physical naming strategy with CamelCaseToUnderscoresNamingStrategy. Using this strategy, all dots are replaced by underscores and camel casing is replaced by underscores as well. Additionally, by default, all table names are generated in lower case. For example, a TelephoneNumber entity is mapped to the telephone_number table. If your schema requires mixed-case identifiers, define a custom CamelCaseToUnderscoresNamingStrategy bean, as shown in the following example:
items.translation: 默认情况下，Spring Boot 使用 CamelCaseToUnderscoresNamingStrategy 配置物理命名策略。 使用该策略时，所有点号均替换为下划线，且驼峰式命名中的大写字母也替换为下划线。 此外，默认情况下，所有表名均以小写生成。 例如，TelephoneNumber 实体被映射到 telephone_number 表。 如果您的架构需要混合大小写的标识符，请定义一个自定义的 CamelCaseToUnderscoresNamingStrategy Bean，如下例所示：

items.source: Spring Boot will not search for or use a META-INF/persistence.xml by default. If you prefer to use a traditional persistence.xml, you need to define your own @Bean of type LocalEntityManagerFactoryBean (with an ID of ‘entityManagerFactory’) and set the persistence unit name there.
items.translation: Spring Boot 默认不会搜索或使用 META-INF/persistence.xml。如果您更喜欢使用传统的 persistence.xml，您需要定义一个类型为 @Bean 的自定义 Bean（ID 为 'entityManagerFactory'），其类型为 LocalEntityManagerFactoryBean，并在那里设置持久化单元名称。

items.source: The spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto is a special case, because, depending on runtime conditions, it has different defaults. If an embedded database is used and no schema manager (such as Liquibase or Flyway) is handling the DataSource, it defaults to create-drop. In all other cases, it defaults to none.
items.translation: `spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto` 是一个特殊情况，因为根据运行时条件，它具有不同的默认值。如果使用了嵌入式数据库，且没有架构管理器（如 Liquibase 或 Flyway）来管理 DataSource，则默认值为 `create-drop`。在所有其他情况下，它默认值为 `none`。

items.source: This customizer will configure Hibernate to use the same CacheManager as the one that the application uses. It is also possible to use separate CacheManager instances. For details, see the Hibernate user guide.
items.translation: 此自定义器将配置 Hibernate 使用与应用程序相同的CacheManager。 也可以使用独立的CacheManager实例。 有关详细信息，请参阅Hibernate 用户指南。

items.source: Spring Boot exposes a set of useful properties (from the spring.data.rest namespace) that customize the RepositoryRestConfiguration. If you need to provide additional customization, you should use a RepositoryRestConfigurer bean.
items.translation: Spring Boot 暴露了一组有用的属性（来自 spring.data.rest 命名空间），用于自定义 RepositoryRestConfiguration。 如果您需要提供额外的自定义，应使用一个 RepositoryRestConfigurer Bean。

items.source: For many applications, all you need is to put the right Spring Data dependencies on your classpath. There is a spring-boot-starter-data-jpa for JPA, spring-boot-starter-data-mongodb for Mongodb, and various other starters for supported technologies. To get started, create some repository interfaces to handle your @Entity objects.
items.translation: 对于许多应用程序，您只需在类路径上添加正确的 Spring Data 依赖项即可。JPA 有 spring-boot-starter-data-jpa，MongoDB 有 spring-boot-starter-data-mongodb，以及各种其他支持技术的启动器。要开始使用，请创建一些仓库接口来处理您的 @Entity 对象。

items.source: Spring Boot determines the location of your Repository implementations by scanning the auto-configuration packages. For more control, use the @Enable…Repositories annotations from Spring Data.
items.translation: Spring Boot 通过扫描自动配置包来确定您的Repository实现的位置。 如需更精细的控制，请使用 Spring Data 中的@Enable…Repositories注解。

items.source: See HibernateJpaAutoConfiguration and JpaBaseConfiguration for more details.
items.translation: 有关更多详细信息，请参阅HibernateJpaAutoConfiguration和JpaBaseConfiguration。

items.source: By default, Spring Boot registers a BeanContainer implementation that uses the BeanFactory so that converters and entity listeners can use regular dependency injection.
items.translation: 默认情况下，Spring Boot 注册了一个 BeanContainer 实现，该实现使用 BeanFactory，以便转换器和实体监听器可以使用常规的依赖注入。

items.source: To take full control of the configuration of the EntityManagerFactory, you need to add a @Bean named ‘entityManagerFactory’. Spring Boot auto-configuration switches off its entity manager in the presence of a bean of that type.
items.translation: 要完全控制 EntityManagerFactory 的配置，您需要添加一个名为 'entityManagerFactory' 的 @Bean。 Spring Boot 自动配置在检测到该类型的 Bean 时，会关闭其实体管理器。

items.source: You should provide a similar configuration for any more additional data sources for which you need JPA access. To complete the picture, you need to configure a JpaTransactionManager for each EntityManagerFactory as well. Alternatively, you might be able to use a JTA transaction manager that spans both.
items.translation: 您应为任何需要 JPA 访问的额外数据源提供类似的配置。为了完善配置，您还需要为每个 EntityManagerFactory 配置一个 JpaTransactionManager。或者，您可能可以使用跨越两者的 JTA 事务管理器。

items.source: There are also flags (spring.data.*.repositories.enabled and spring.data.*.repositories.type) that you can use to switch the auto-configured repositories on and off in external configuration. Doing so is useful, for instance, in case you want to switch off the Mongo repositories and still use the auto-configured MongoTemplate.
items.translation: 此外，还有标志（`spring.data.*.repositories.enabled` 和 `spring.data.*.repositories.type`），您可以在外部配置中使用它们来切换自动配置的存储库的开启或关闭。这样做很有用，例如，如果您想关闭 Mongo 存储库但仍使用自动配置的 MongoTemplate。

items.source: If you need to use jOOQ with multiple data sources, you should create your own DSLContext for each one. See JooqAutoConfiguration for more details.
items.translation: 如果您需要使用 jOOQ 配合多个数据源，应为每个数据源创建自己的 DSLContext。有关更多详细信息，请参阅 JooqAutoConfiguration。

items.source: Assuming that SomeDataSource has regular JavaBean properties for the URL, the username, and the pool size, these settings are bound automatically before the DataSource is made available to other components.
items.translation: 假设 SomeDataSource 具有用于 URL、用户名和连接池大小的常规 JavaBean 属性，则在向其他组件提供 DataSource 之前会自动绑定这些设置。

items.source: In addition, all properties in spring.jpa.properties.* are passed through as normal JPA properties (with the prefix stripped) when the local EntityManagerFactory is created.
items.translation: 此外，在创建本地 EntityManagerFactory 时，spring.jpa.properties.* 中的所有属性都会作为普通 JPA 属性（去掉前缀）传递。

items.source: For example, if you want to configure Hibernate’s batch size you must use spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.jdbc.batch_size. If you use other forms, such as batchSize or batch-size, Hibernate will not apply the setting.
items.translation: 例如，如果您要配置 Hibernate 的批量大小，必须使用 spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.jdbc.batch_size。如果使用其他形式，如 batchSize 或 batch-size，Hibernate 将不会应用该设置。

items.source: Spring Boot also provides a utility builder class, called DataSourceBuilder, that can be used to create one of the standard data sources (if it is on the classpath). The builder can detect which one to use based on what is available on the classpath. It also auto-detects the driver based on the JDBC URL.

items.source: Spring Data provides web support that simplifies the use of Spring Data repositories in a web application. Spring Boot provides properties in the spring.data.web namespace for customizing its configuration. Note that if you are using Spring Data REST, you must use the properties in the spring.data.rest namespace instead.
items.translation: Spring Data 提供了 Web 支持，简化了在 Web 应用程序中使用 Spring Data 存储库。 Spring Boot 在 spring.data.web 命名空间中提供了属性，用于自定义其配置。 请注意，如果您使用的是 Spring Data REST，则必须使用 spring.data.rest 命名空间中的属性。

items.source: Spring Data REST can expose the Repository implementations as REST endpoints for you, provided Spring MVC has been enabled for the application.
items.translation: Spring Data REST 可以将 Repository 实现暴露为 REST 端点，前提是已为应用程序启用了 Spring MVC。

items.source:
If you want to configure a component that JPA uses, then you need to ensure that the component is initialized before JPA.
When the component is auto-configured, Spring Boot takes care of this for you.
For example, when Flyway is auto-configured, Hibernate is configured to depend on Flyway so that Flyway has a chance to initialize the database before Hibernate tries to use it.
items.translation: 如果您要配置 JPA 使用的组件，则需确保该组件在 JPA 之前初始化。当组件进行自动配置时，Spring Boot 会为您处理此问题。例如，当 Flyway 被自动配置时，Hibernate 会被配置为依赖于 Flyway，以便 Hibernate 尝试使用数据库之前，Flyway 有机会先初始化数据库。

items.source: When you create a bean for LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean yourself, any customization that was applied during the creation of the auto-configured LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean is lost. Make sure to use the auto-configured EntityManagerFactoryBuilder to retain JPA and vendor properties. This is particularly important if you were relying on spring.jpa.* properties for configuring things like the naming strategy or the DDL mode.
items.translation: 如果您自己创建 LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean 的 Bean，则在自动配置的 LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean 创建期间应用的任何自定义设置都会丢失。 请确保使用自动配置的 EntityManagerFactoryBuilder 以保留 JPA 和供应商属性。 如果您依赖 spring.jpa.* 属性来配置命名策略或 DDL 模式等设置，这一点尤为重要。

items.source: In particular, ExceptionTranslatorExecuteListener and SpringTransactionProvider can be reused to provide similar features to what the auto-configuration does with a single DataSource.
items.translation: 特别是，ExceptionTranslatorExecuteListener 和 SpringTransactionProvider 可以重复使用，以提供与自动配置使用单个 DataSource 时类似的功能。

items.source: If you need to apply advanced customization to Hibernate properties, consider registering a HibernatePropertiesCustomizer bean that will be invoked prior to creating the EntityManagerFactory. This takes precedence over anything that is applied by the auto-configuration.
items.translation: 如果需要对 Hibernate 属性应用高级自定义，请考虑注册一个 HibernatePropertiesCustomizer Bean，该 Bean 将在创建 EntityManagerFactory 之前被调用。 此设置优先于自动配置所应用的所有内容。

items.source: Spring Boot will expose Hikari-specific settings to spring.datasource.hikari. This example uses a more generic configuration sub namespace as the example does not support multiple datasource implementations.

items.source: If you do not specify any order on your custom RepositoryRestConfigurer, it runs after the one Spring Boot uses internally. If you need to specify an order, make sure it is higher than 0.
items.translation: 如果您未为自定义的 RepositoryRestConfigurer 指定任何顺序，它将在 Spring Boot 内部使用的配置器之后运行。 如果您需要指定顺序，请确保其值大于 0。
